title: lansium aqueum
intro: Lansium aqueum, commonly known as the Langsat or Longkong, is a tropical tree native to Southeast Asia and is a member of the Meliaceae family. The Langsat fruit has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and aiding in digestion, due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Lansium aqueum include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in protecting against oxidative stress, infections, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
